activities.title: Qualitative Error Taxonomies: Hallucinations, Format Violations & Refusals

source_resources.title: Survey of Hallucination in Natural Language Generation
source_resources.author: Ziwei Ji, Nayeon Lee, Rita Frieske, Tiezheng Yu, Dan Su, Yan Xu, Etsuko Ishii, Ye Jin Bang, Andrea Madotto, Pascale Fung
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic citation of the NLG failure survey.
source_resources.prerequisites: Natural language generation, factuality evaluation, intrinsic vs extrinsic hallucination.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary taxonomy of hallucinations in NLG, formalizing the critical distinction between intrinsic hallucinations (contradicting source input context) and extrinsic hallucinations (asserting unverifiable external facts).
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Freely available on arXiv and ACM Digital Library.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The intrinsic/extrinsic taxonomy, fact-verification prompt protocols, and error attribution workflows are completely developed in lesson modules.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Maynez et al. On Faithfulness and Factuality in Abstractive Summarization
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Focuses on abstractive summarization faithfulness; Ji et al. provides the overarching taxonomy across dialogue, QA, and generation.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Huang et al. A Survey on Hallucination in Large Language Models: Principles, Taxonomy, Challenges, and Open Questions
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Follow-up survey on LLMs; Ji et al. sets out the taxonomy distinctions utilized across evaluation literature.

source_resources.title: XSTest: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety Behaviors in Large Language Models
source_resources.author: Paul Röttger, Hannah Rose Kirk, Bertie Vidgen, Giuseppe Attanasio, Federico Bianchi, Dirk Hovy
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic citation of safety evaluation benchmark.
source_resources.prerequisites: Safety alignment, refusal classifiers, false-positive safety evaluation.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Groundbreaking benchmark identifying exaggerated safety behaviors and false-positive refusals, formalizing test suites that contrast real unsafe prompts against benign prompts with sensitive lexical overlap.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Freely available on arXiv and GitHub.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The 10 refusal prompt categories, refusal detection regex/heuristics, and over-refusal error quantification are implemented in lesson exercises.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Shaikh et al. On Second Thought, Let's Not Think Step by Step! Bias and Toxicity in Zero-Shot Reasoning
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Shows that zero-shot chain-of-thought increases biased and toxic outputs on harmful prompts; XSTest provides an explicit, quantitative evaluation dataset for measuring unnecessary refusal rates.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Bianchi et al. Safety-Tuned LLaMAs: Lessons from Improving the Safety of a Very Large Language Model
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Safety fine-tuning methodology; XSTest isolates the diagnostic metric for detecting exaggerated refusal side effects.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Section 4.4 Results on Unsafe Prompts and Appendix D Details on Automated Evaluation

source_resources.title: Overcoming Catastrophic Forgetting in Neural Networks
source_resources.author: James Kirkpatrick, Razvan Pascanu, Neil Rabinowitz, Joel Veness, Guillaume Desjardins, Andrei A. Rusu, et al.
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic citation of foundational continual learning literature.
source_resources.prerequisites: Neural network weight drift, Fisher information matrix, continual learning.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Foundational paper formalizing catastrophic forgetting during continual fine-tuning, explaining why updating parameters on domain distributions causes dramatic capability loss on pretraining tasks.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Freely available on arXiv and PNAS.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Mathematical explanation of weight trajectory divergence, Fisher regularized objectives, and forgetting audit protocols are integrated into the lesson.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: French. Catastrophic Forgetting in Connectionist Networks (Trends in Cognitive Sciences 1999)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Cognitive science perspective; Kirkpatrick et al. provides the modern deep neural network gradient formulation (EWC).

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Zenke et al. Continual Learning Through Synaptic Intelligence
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Online path integral regularization; Kirkpatrick introduces the benchmark standard for evaluating catastrophic forgetting.

source_resources.title: An Empirical Study of Catastrophic Forgetting in Large Language Models During Continual Fine-tuning
source_resources.author: Yun Luo, Zhen Yang, Fandong Meng, Yingxue Liu, Jie Zhou, Yue Zhang
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic citation of LLM continual fine-tuning research.
source_resources.prerequisites: Instruction fine-tuning, general capability retention, LoRA vs full fine-tuning degradation.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Rigorous empirical investigation demonstrating how domain fine-tuning degrades foundation LLMs across reasoning, coding, and general instruction following, comparing full fine-tuning against parameter-efficient adapters.
source_resources.safe_fallback: General benchmark regression tests, forgetting audit templates, and pre/post radar chart analysis are completely provided.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Scialom et al. Fine-tuned Language Models are Continual Learners
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Focuses on QA domain transfers; Luo et al. comprehensively assesses broad LLM capability collapse across multiple benchmark domains.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Zhai et al. Investigating the Catastrophic Forgetting in Multimodal Large Language Models
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Studies forgetting after fine-tuning multimodal LLMs; Luo et al. targets text-only LLM continual fine-tuning and compares adapter-based with full-parameter tuning.

source_resources.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
source_resources.author: Hugo Touvron, Louis Martin, Kevin Stone, Peter Albert, Amjad Almahairi, et al.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Defines the standard LLaMA-2 instruction format ([INST] <<SYS>> ... <</SYS>> [/INST]) and analyzes token boundary alignment impact on generation stability.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The LLaMA-2 prompt structure, token boundary rules, and comparative analysis are fully worked out in curriculum lessons.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Touvron et al. LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Original foundation model paper without conversational chat tuning details; LLaMA-2 formalizes dialogue formatting.
Adopts similar [INST] formatting; LLaMA-2 provides the foundational ablation on system prompt integration.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Section 3.4 RLHF Results and Section 4.4 Safety Evaluation of Llama 2-Chat

source_resources.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
source_resources.author: Long Ouyang, Jeffrey Wu, Xu Jiang, Diogo Almeida, Carroll Wainwright, Pamela Mishkin, et al.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Foundational InstructGPT paper defining the SFT objective: maximizing log-likelihood of demonstrator completions conditioned on prompts.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The conditional likelihood objective and prompt-conditioning derivations are completely formulated in the review.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Ziegler et al. Fine-Tuning Language Models from Human Preferences
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Earlier RLHF formulation on summarization; InstructGPT standardizes the prompt-response SFT training phase.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Chung et al. Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models (Flan-PaLM)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Focuses on massive multi-task scaling; InstructGPT details the exact prompt-conditioned loss setup.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Section 4.2 Results on public NLP datasets ('alignment tax') and Appendix E.1

source_resources.title: Hugging Face LLM Evaluation Guidebook (legacy edition)
source_resources.author: Hugging Face evaluation-guidebook contributors
source_resources.version_or_verification_date: Public edition checked 2026-11-01; moving pages may change
source_resources.permission_basis: External hyperlink only; no third-party prose, exercises, code or translations are imported.
source_resources.prerequisites: Held-out data, basic language-model metrics and experimental comparisons.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Teaching-oriented evaluation design and reproducibility guidance complements the benchmark papers. Stable methodological chapters only; not a current tooling/version reference.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: README says no longer maintained. The replacement OpenEvals Space was not verified as containing the guidebook; its license and content are not substituted. No bootstrap derivation is claimed.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Use the original localized explanations, exercises and checks already present in this activity; no external account or purchase is required for that fallback.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Retained for the multi-metric framework; the guidebook makes practical choices easier to teach.
Useful implementation cross-check; tool configuration alone does not teach metric choice or evaluator limitations.

source_resources.title: Model Cards for Model Reporting
source_resources.author: Margaret Mitchell, Simone Wu, Andrew Zaldivar, Parker Barnes, Lucy Vasserman, Ben Hutchinson, Elena Spitzer, Inioluwa Deborah Raji, Timnit Gebru
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic citation of AI transparency standard.
source_resources.prerequisites: Evaluation reporting, demographic and performance slicing, model limitations and caveats.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary standard for structured, transparent model reporting, mandating explicit disclosure of intended uses, evaluation slices, out-of-scope tasks, ethical considerations, and negative results.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Complete Model Card Markdown templates, section schemas, and evaluation disclosure checklists are provided in the curriculum.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Bommasani et al. The Foundation Model Transparency Index
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Corporate transparency audit index; Mitchell et al. provides the concrete technical artifact specification for individual model releases.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Pushkarna et al. Data Cards: Purposeful and Transparent Dataset Documentation for Responsible AI
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Dataset documentation focus; Mitchell et al. provides the required specification for trained model artifact reporting.

source_resources.title: Datasheets for Datasets
source_resources.author: Timnit Gebru, Jamie Morgenstern, Briana Vecchione, Jennifer Wortman Vaughan, Hanna Wallach, Hal Daumé III, Kate Crawford
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic citation of dataset governance literature.
source_resources.prerequisites: Dataset provenance, curation motivation, preprocessing transparency, maintenance lifecycle.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Foundational literature introducing standardized documentation for machine learning datasets, specifying questions on dataset composition, collection mechanisms, preprocessing, and distribution rights.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Freely available on arXiv and ACM.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Datasheet questionnaires, provenance schemas, and dataset auditing checklists are completely integrated into lesson materials.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Bender & Friedman. Data Statements for Natural Language Processing: Toward Mitigating System Bias and Enabling Better Science
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Linguistic demographic documentation focus; Gebru et al. provides the universal engineering datasheet framework adopted across AI.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Holland et al. The Dataset Nutrition Label: A Framework to Drive Higher Data Quality Standards
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Nutrition label metaphor; Gebru et al. is a widely cited framework for dataset documentation in both academic and industrial practice.
